scope.calendar_basis: Repeated day patterns in local time. Fixed 06:00 public start is a planning assumption. Annual wages include relief from the source role pool. Civil crews are budgeted over the full reservation window, with effective availability from the source plan.
scope.cost_basis: Programme labour, intake and operating-year payroll have separate periods. These are allowances inside the fleet, civil, commissioning and operating accounts. Match contract exclusions and labour credits before substituting them.

scope.scope_boundaries: No named staff, awarded shifts or authorisation. Peak role/shift coverage is a workload screen. Onboard scenarios distribute annual duty using the departure profile where available.
